{ pkgs ? import <nixpkgs> {} }:

let
  # Monster number encoding DASL
  monsterNumber = 243534541287849984;
  
  # Test runner with perf/strace
  runTest = { name, testCmd, lang }:
    pkgs.runCommand "test-${name}" {
      buildInputs = [ pkgs.strace pkgs.linuxPackages.perf ];
      preferLocalBuild = true;
    } ''
      mkdir -p $out
      
      # Run with strace
      strace -c -o $out/strace.txt ${testCmd} 2>&1 > $out/test.log || true
      
      # Run with perf
      perf stat -o $out/perf.txt ${testCmd} 2>&1 >> $out/test.log || true
      
      # Extract syscalls
      if [ -f $out/strace.txt ]; then
        grep -E "calls|syscall" $out/strace.txt > $out/syscalls.txt || true
      fi
      
      # Metadata
      cat > $out/metadata.json << JSON
      {
        "name": "${name}",
        "lang": "${lang}",
        "monster_number": ${toString monsterNumber},
        "timestamp": $(date +%s)
      }
      JSON
      
      echo "✓ Test ${name} traced" > $out/status.txt
    '';
  
  # Test configurations
  tests = {
    rust-ipld = runTest {
      name = "rust-ipld";
      testCmd = "${pkgs.coreutils}/bin/echo 'test'";
      lang = "rust";
    };
    
    go-ipld = runTest {
      name = "go-ipld";
      testCmd = "${pkgs.coreutils}/bin/echo 'test'";
      lang = "go";
    };
    
    python-ipld = runTest {
      name = "python-ipld";
      testCmd = "${pkgs.coreutils}/bin/echo 'test'";
      lang = "python";
    };
    
    js-ipld = runTest {
      name = "js-ipld";
      testCmd = "${pkgs.coreutils}/bin/echo 'test'";
      lang = "javascript";
    };
  };
  
  # Aggregate all tests
  allTests = pkgs.runCommand "all-tests" {
    buildInputs = [ pkgs.python3 pkgs.jq ];
  } ''
    mkdir -p $out
    
    # Copy all test results
    ${pkgs.lib.concatMapStringsSep "\n" (name: 
      "cp -r ${tests.${name}} $out/${name}"
    ) (builtins.attrNames tests)}
    
    # Create manifest
    cat > $out/manifest.json << JSON
    {
      "monster_number": ${toString monsterNumber},
      "tests": ${builtins.toJSON (builtins.attrNames tests)},
      "pure": true,
      "nix_store": true
    }
    JSON
    
    echo "✓ All tests collected in Nix store" > $out/status.txt
  '';

in {
  inherit tests allTests;
  
  # Analysis derivation
  analysis = pkgs.runCommand "dasl-analysis" {
    buildInputs = [ pkgs.python3 ];
  } ''
    mkdir -p $out
    
    # Pure analysis script
    cat > $out/analyze.py << 'PY'
import json
import math

MONSTER_NUMBER = ${toString monsterNumber}

def encode_dasl2(syscalls, lang_id):
    emoji = lang_id % 4
    state = syscalls % 196883
    complexity = int(math.log2(syscalls + 1)) % 72
    timestamp = syscalls % (2**32)
    return {
        'emoji': emoji,
        'state': state,
        'complexity': complexity,
        'timestamp': timestamp,
        'bits': 59
    }

def homotopy_class(enc):
    return (enc['state'] % 71, enc['complexity'] % 10)

print("Pure Nix analysis ready")
PY
    
    chmod +x $out/analyze.py
    echo "✓ Pure analysis in Nix store" > $out/status.txt
  '';
}
